mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(O.OBJ_OWNER, '') as "objOwner", O.OBJ_NM as "objNm", O.OBJ_NM_KR as "objNmKr", O.OBJ_COMMENT as "objComment", O.TABLESPACE_NM as "tablespaceNm", (SELECT B.BIZ_AREA_NM FROM TB_BIZ_AREA B WHERE B.BIZ_AREA_ID = O.BIZ_AREA_ID AND COALESCE(B.USE_YN, 'Y') = 'Y') as "bizAreaNm", (SELECT S.SUBJ_AREA_NM FROM TB_SUBJ_AREA S WHERE S.SUBJ_AREA_ID = O.SUBJ_AREA_ID AND COALESCE(S.USE_YN, 'Y') = 'Y') as "subjAreaNm", O.APRV_STATUS as "aprvStatus", O.REQUESTER_USER_ID as "requesterUserId" FROM TB_DATA_MODEL_OBJ O WHERE O.DM_ID = #{value} AND COALESCE(O.USE_YN, 'Y') = 'Y' ORDER BY 1, 2

SELECT COALESCE(A.OBJ_OWNER, '') as "objOwner", A.OBJ_NM as "objNm", A.ATTR_ORD as "attrOrd", A.ATTR_NM as "attrNm", A.ATTR_NM_KR as "attrNmKr", A.DATA_TYPE as "dataType", A.DATA_LEN as "dataLen", A.DATA_DECIMAL_LEN as "dataDecimalLen", A.PK_YN as "pkYn", A.FK_YN as "fkYn", A.NULLABLE_YN as "nullableYn", A.DEFAULT_VAL as "defaultVal", A.ATTR_COMMENT as "attrComment", A.TERMS_STND_YN as "termsStndYn", A.DOMAIN_STND_YN as "domainStndYn", A.WORD_LST as "wordLst", A.FK_PARENT_OBJ_OWNER as "fkParentObjOwner", A.FK_PARENT_OBJ_NM as "fkParentObjNm", A.FK_PARENT_ATTR_NM as "fkParentAttrNm", A.APRV_STATUS as "aprvStatus", A.REQUESTER_USER_ID as "requesterUserId" FROM TB_DATA_MODEL_ATTR A JOIN TB_DATA_MODEL_OBJ O ON O.DM_ID = A.DM_ID AND COALESCE(O.OBJ_OWNER, '') = COALESCE(A.OBJ_OWNER, '') AND O.OBJ_NM = A.OBJ_NM AND COALESCE(O.USE_YN, 'Y') = 'Y' WHERE A.DM_ID = #{value} AND COALESCE(A.USE_YN, 'Y') = 'Y' ORDER BY 1, 2, 3

SELECT OBJ_OWNER as "objOwner", TABLE_NM as "tableNm", INDEX_NM as "indexNm", INDEX_TYPE as "indexType", UNIQUENESS as "uniqueness", COLUMN_NM as "columnNm", COLUMN_POS as "columnPos", SORT_ORDER as "sortOrder", TABLESPACE_NM as "tablespaceNm", APRV_STATUS as "aprvStatus", REQUESTER_USER_ID as "requesterUserId" FROM TB_DATA_MODEL_INDEX WHERE DM_ID = #{value} AND USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY OBJ_OWNER, TABLE_NM, INDEX_NM, COLUMN_POS

SELECT J.DIAG_JOB_ID as "diagJobId", J.TOTAL_CNT as "totalCnt", J.RESULT_CNT as "resultCnt", to_char(to_timestamp(J.END_DT, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as "endDt", J.CRET_USER_ID as "cretUserId", (SELECT D.DICT_NM FROM TB_STD_DICT D WHERE D.DICT_ID = J.DICT_ID) as "dictNm" FROM TB_DIAG_JOB J WHERE J.DM_ID = #{value} AND J.STATUS = 'DONE' ORDER BY J.END_DT DESC NULLS LAST, J.CRET_DT DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT COALESCE(R.OBJ_OWNER, '') as "objOwner", R.OBJ_NM as "objNm", R.ATTR_NM as "attrNm", R.ATTR_NM_KR as "attrNmKr", R.DIAG_TYPE as "diagType", R.DIAG_DETAIL as "diagDetail", R.STD_VALUE as "stdValue", R.ACTUAL_VALUE as "actualValue" FROM TB_DIAG_RESULT R WHERE R.DIAG_JOB_ID = #{value} ORDER BY 1, 2, 3, 5

SELECT H.CHANGE_SEQ as "changeSeq", H.CHANGE_DT as "changeDt", H.CHANGE_USER_ID as "changeUserId", (SELECT U.NM FROM TB_USER U WHERE U.USER_ID = H.CHANGE_USER_ID) as "changeUserNm", H.CHANGE_TYPE as "changeType", COALESCE(H.OBJ_OWNER, '') as "objOwner", H.OBJ_NM as "objNm", H.ATTR_NM as "attrNm", H.CONSTRAINT_NM as "constraintNm", H.INDEX_NM as "indexNm", H.APRV_STATUS as "aprvStatus", H.APRV_USER_ID as "aprvUserId", H.APRV_DT as "aprvDt", H.SUBMIT_DT as "submitDt" FROM TB_DATA_MODEL_CHANGE_HISTORY H WHERE H.DM_ID = #{dmId} AND H.CHANGE_DT >= #{fromDt} AND H.APRV_STATUS IN ('DRAFT', 'SUBMITTED') AND H.CHANGE_USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY H.CHANGE_DT DESC, H.CHANGE_SEQ DESC
SELECT DISTINCT UPPER(W.WORD_ENG_ABRV_NM) FROM TB_WORD W WHERE W.APRV_YN = 'Y' AND W.WORD_ENG_ABRV_NM IS NOT NULL AND W.DICT_ID IN #{d}
